name: echo-desktop-ops
description: Truthful ECHO control deck for Codex Desktop with RAM, QUENCH GPU, fleet nodes, OpenClaw, model catalogs, Swarm readiness, GitHub, and CertForge gates.

interface.shortDescription: Measured ECHO, fleet, OpenClaw, RAM, GPU, model, and build-gate status.
interface.longDescription: A supported Codex/ChatGPT Desktop plugin with an embedded MCP App control deck. It measures RAM and QUENCH GPU, consumes the governed fleet collector, integrates bounded read-only OpenClaw probes, distinguishes native and external model catalogs, and exposes GitHub/CertForge policy state without modifying the signed desktop package.
defaultPrompt: Open my ECHO Desktop Control Deck.
Refresh RAM, QUENCH GPU, fleet, and OpenClaw status.
Check Astra, SOL 6.1, external model, and Swarm readiness.
